clips.title: The story
paras: Deep in Windshear Mine, Piznik watches the Venture Company at work. Once second-in-command, he was pushed aside by Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle and now plots against his former boss.

Before Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle took control of Windshear Crag, Piznik ranked second across the entire operation. When Gerenzo seized authority, the Venture Company pushed Piznik aside and sent him into the depths of Windshear Mine. Piznik has not accepted the demotion quietly. Underground, he watches the mine's movements and waits for a chance to take revenge on the boss who demoted him.
